QuestInfo.name: Beginner Bowman's Third Training Session
QuestInfo.0: You're really starting to get into this training thing. #b#p1012100##k wants to give you another session.
QuestInfo.1: #p1012100# says Bowmen must be calm and possess a lot of will power. She says you must hunt #r30 #o0210100#s#k. That's, uh, quite a lot, but you can do it. \n\n#o0210100# #r#a21381##k
QuestInfo.2: You took care of 30 #o0210100#s. It wasn't easy, but you did it!

0.0: 미숙한 팔을 가진 궁수여. 성장하는 당신의 모습에 감탄하게 되네요. 당신의 눈은 이미 또 한 명의 강력한 궁수의 것이에요. 하지만... 아직 당신에게는 부족한 것이 있군요. 더 큰 성장을 위해 한 번 더 수련을 받아보겠어요?

yes.0: 좋은 결심이에요. 이번에 자네가 해야 할 일은 슬라임 65마리를 사냥하는 것이에요. 65마리... 결코 적지 않은 숫자이지요. 하지만 궁수의 침착성과 의지라면 얼마든지 상대할 수 있는 수예요. 자, 어서 당신의 힘을 보여주세요.

no.0: 스스로의 힘으로 수련할 수 있다면, 더 이상 권하지 않겠어요.

0.0: Bowman with unskilled arms. I'm impressed by your enhancement. Your eyes already reveal you have grown as a Bowman. But, would you like to go for one more training for further improvement?

yes.0: That's a good decision. This time, you must hunt #r30 #o0210100#s#k. I know that's not a small number, but with a Bowman's patience and will, you will be more than able to fight them. Now, show me your strength.

no.0: If you train by yourself, I won't ask you anymore.

1.0: You've hunted 30 #o0210100#s. You have completed a difficult training. I hold you in high regard.

yes.0: I'll call you when you need more training. Keep training yourself.

mob.0: You haven't hunted #r30 #o0210100#s#k yet. Don't be impatient. If you want to become stronger, you must persist.
